finalBehavior.behavior: A structured credential rejection remains definitive=true only when it is the first credential-classifiable outcome in the operation.

If a prior response or other non-credential outcome already made the operation mixed, a later structured credential rejection stops the current model loop and returns definitiveCredentialRejection=false. Remaining models and later credentials are not dispatched.

A credential-only first rejection still rotates to the next credential and can recover. Transport uncertainty still stops without model or credential fallback. Parse failures and supported fallback statuses may still advance models until a credential rejection or uncertain outcome stops the operation.
